messages.subject: glm problem: taking out factors
messages.body_plain:

messages.subject_clean: [StatForLing with R] glm problem: taking out factors
messages.body_plain:
You can't take out a combination of factor levels - genderm:age70-79
with update - only a combination of factors, e.g. gender:factor (which
in your case will probably turn out to be significant, however).
STG
--
Stefan Th. Gries

University of California, Santa Barbara
http://www.linguistics.ucsb.edu/faculty/stgries
